name: best_search2
description: Second search: does a LARGER weakspot lift the whole-area advantage? Whole-area gain is bounded by (weakspot area fraction) x (in-weakspot error cut); with a ~5% weakspot that caps the gap near -0.1. This co-varies radius (bigger withheld region) with n_select and kernel width in the undertrained regime (iters 12, n_train 100, mix 0.5) to find where guided wins the whole area more decisively. LOESS/RBF/Local GPR for comparison, 10 seeds.
